{"metadata":{"description":"将多个 DeepSeek Harness 对话融合为一个可继续的会话，支持 Agent 智能剪枝、话题分组、内容排序和界面操作","id":"gh:1333885547","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-fusion","slug":"omdsh-dev/dsh-fusion","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"将多个 DeepSeek Harness 对话融合为一个可继续的会话，支持 Agent 智能剪枝、话题分组、内容排序和界面操作"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-fusion"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness bundle that fuses the current model surfaces of two or more sessions into one ind"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ependently identified, titled, durable, and continuable conversation whose retained messages are nat"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ive target-session log events. Source sessions are never modified."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Capabilities"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Fuses 2–32 conversations; the deployment default limit is 8.
- Orders projected messages chronolog"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ically or groups them by caller-selected source order.
- Deduplicates shared fork prefixes by stable"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" message id without collapsing coincidentally identical prose.
- Projects text from user and assista"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"nt messages while excluding reasoning, tool calls, and tool results.
- Inherits the caller's cwd, pr"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ovider/model options, and creation-time agent preset.
- Attaches the target to the caller/source Wor"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"kspace group when the optional Host Workspace registry is available.
- Uses an explicit title, then "},{"id":"p6s7","text":"an Agent-planned title, then a readable title derived from the source conversation titles.
- Seeds a"},{"id":"p6s8","text":" deterministic `session/title`, an ignorable provenance manifest, one untrusted-history boundary, an"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"d native `user/message` / `assistant/message` events with valid target-owned turn/step brackets, the"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"n requests a persistence flush.
- Restricts sources to the caller's cwd by default; a deployment mus"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"t explicitly enable cross-workspace fusion.
- Optionally runs a temporary, tool-free DSH Agent to ju"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"dge fusion value and return a strictly validated pruning, topic-grouping, and ordering plan."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"This repository is a DSH bundle with `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Restart DSH after installation. The profile loads `@deepseek-ai/dsh-fusion`; the `/fuse` entry appea"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"rs in the slash menu and `conversation_fuse` appears in the model tool catalog. The selected profile"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" must provide `agents`, `commands`, `sessions`, `sessionQuery`, `systemPrompt`, and `tools`. Composi"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"tions that provide an `invariants` service may mount the optional `@deepseek-ai/dsh-fusion/invariant"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"` entry separately; the default bundle does not enable it."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## UI command"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Click **Fuse conversations** in any DSH conversation Header. The dialog includes the current convers"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ation automatically and lists other nonblank conversations in the same workspace. It supports source"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" search and multi-selection, an optional title (leave it blank to generate one from the source title"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"s), chronological or source-grouped ordering, fork-history deduplication, and optional intelligent A"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"gent planning. The planning Agent can decline an incoherent fusion or prune, group, and reorder usef"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"ul material. After creation, the new conversation joins the same Workspace group and the dialog can "},{"id":"p12s7","text":"open it as soon as it appears in the session list."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The dialog executes through DSH's command plane. Manual mode makes no extra model request; intellige"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"nt planning sends only the authorized, projected, byte-bounded candidate snapshot to a temporary DSH"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" Agent. The text command remains available:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"For example, from `session-research`:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The current conversation is included automatically, so the command accepts only the other source ids"},{"id":"p17s2","text":". Spaces and commas are accepted as separators. It runs without a model call, creates the fused conv"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ersation with chronological ordering and fork-prefix deduplication, then reports the new session id "},{"id":"p17s4","text":"for opening from the conversation list. Invalid, missing, or cross-workspace sources are reported di"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"the conversation list. Invalid, missing, or cross-workspace sources are reported directly in the UI."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Tool"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"`conversation_fuse` accepts:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| `sourceSessionIds` | `string[]` | yes | At least two unique source ids. |
| `targetSessionId` | `s"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"tring` | no | New id; defaults to `fusion-<uuid>`. |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"#### What the model sees"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"A stable instruction explains when to call `conversation_fuse`, and the tool schema requires explici"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ruction explains when to call `conversation_fuse`, and the tool schema requires explicit source ids."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"#### What the model sees"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The new conversation contains a short recall boundary followed by one native user/assistant surface "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"event per retained source message. Its raw log also contains valid target-owned turn/step brackets a"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"nd an ignorable provenance manifest with source references, planning facts, and retention statistics"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"; transcript text is not duplicated into that manifest."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"#### What the model sees"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Structured creation and retention facts plus a short rendered summary naming the new session and tit"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"uctured creation and retention facts plus a short rendered summary naming the new session and title."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"#### What the model sees"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Only with `agentPlanning: true`, a temporary DSH Agent sees a complete planning-only system prompt a"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"nd the already projected, deduplicated, bounded candidate JSON marked as untrusted. It must return a"},{"id":"p29s3","text":" structured verdict, reason, suggested title, strategy, and topic groups containing exact message re"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"ed verdict, reason, suggested title, strategy, and topic groups containing exact message references."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- **Snapshot only** — later source updates do not propagate.
- **Text projection** — images, reasoni"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ng, tool calls, and tool results are omitted pending portable attachment and tool-correlation projec"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"tions.
- **One working directory** — the new session inherits the caller cwd and its matching Worksp"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"ace membership; cross-workspace fusion does not merge filesystem authority or attach the target to f"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"oreign Workspace groups.
- **Optional Workspace service** — minimal standalone compositions without "},{"id":"p31s6","text":"`workspaceRegistry` still create a valid session, but no group exists to inherit there.
- **Creation"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"-header preset** — a blank session switched to another preset later is fused using its creation-time"},{"id":"p31s8","text":" header preset.
- **Post-publication flush failure** — a failed durability checkpoint reports an err"},{"id":"p31s9","text":"or but deliberately leaves the already-published live session intact.
- **Planner model dependency**"},{"id":"p31s10","text":" — intelligent planning inherits the caller's provider/model. Provider failure, truncated output, in"},{"id":"p31s11","text":"valid JSON, or an invalid message reference aborts fusion before the target session is created; manu"},{"id":"p31s12","text":"al mode remains deterministic and model-free."}],"truncated":true}
